sources.title: Kog'Maw Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Icathian Surprise
passive.text: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.text: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.text: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.text: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.text: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

damage.value: Kog'Maw deals sustained magic damage with W-enhanced attacks and true damage with his post-death explosion.

archetype.value: Kog'Maw is played as an ADC, with on-hit and AP build options.

axis.value: Kog'Maw can poke from range with Q, E, and R.

spikes.why: Kog'Maw gains attack range and deals maximum-health magic damage on hit.

mistakes.value: Kog'Maw spends extra Mana by firing multiple Living Artilleries in a short period.
